competency_fulfillment.rationale: The sample set successfully fulfills the competency requirement of illustrating division through equal distribution of objects into several groups. Visual and interactive models concretize this concept, such as seed 50's "This array has 30 squares split into 5 equal rows. How many squares are in each row?" and seed 55's "Shade 12 squares into 2 equal rows. How many squares are in each row?". In addition, word problems such as seed 601's "Moses wants to share 12 baskets equally among 3 friends. How many baskets does each friend get?" directly frame division as equal distribution among entities, while foundational fact items like seed 43's "What is 10 ÷ 2?" reinforce the corresponding mathematical operations.
